data_fields.name: xp_table_thresholds
data_fields.donor_constant: total XP per level (empyrean sample: level 20 = 134217472)

data_fields.name: absolute_level_curve
data_fields.donor_constant: per-table multiplier by enemy level (sample il.txt: level 20 = 508288)

data_fields.name: relative_level_curve
data_fields.donor_constant: per-table multiplier by enemy level minus player level (sample not read); 1 when table absent

data_fields.name: xp_gain_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: stat value; +25 is the example in the donor comment

data_fields.name: dead_frame_xp_block
data_fields.donor_constant: block while hp == 0, rechecked each frame

best_idea: Scale each kill's XP by an enemy-vs-player level-gap curve and carry the fractional remainder into the next award so small rewards are not lost.
decision_why: The level-gap curve and carried remainder fit a server award; the per-frame level derivation and client dead-frame gate do not fit our one ledger, so we keep the shape and the state on the server.
acceptance: A server test asserts a kill 3 levels above the player awards base x relative-curve(+3), two awards of 0.5 XP give one point on the second kill, and after a 10 percent death penalty total XP never falls below the current level threshold.
